description: This file contains the implementation of a utility class 'Paginator' that provides methods for handling list pagination within the OFBiz framework. It includes functions for calculating page indices, list sizes, preparing pagination context, and navigating list iterators, specifically tailored for handling paginated data in a web application context.

classes.name: Paginator
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods to manage list pagination, including index calculations, list limits, and pager preparation.

methods.name: getActualPageSize
methods.description: Returns the actual page size from the context; defaults to highIndex - lowIndex if not explicitly set.

methods.name: getHighIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the high index boundary for pagination from the context.

methods.name: getListLimits
methods.description: Calculates and sets pagination limits such as list size, view index, view size, low and high indices based on the provided list or iterator, and updates the context map accordingly.

methods.name: getListSize
methods.description: Retrieves the total list size from the context.

methods.name: getLowIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the low index boundary for pagination from the context.

methods.name: getViewIndex
methods.description: Determines the current view index for pagination based on the model form and context.

methods.name: getViewSize
methods.description: Determines the view size (page size) for pagination based on the model form and context.

methods.name: preparePager
methods.description: Initializes and prepares the pagination context for displaying a subset of list items, including setting index boundaries and handling list iteration.

methods.name: safeNext
methods.description: Safely advances the iterator, returning null if NoSuchElementException occurs.
